controller.firmware_gate: custom FREEAXE board profile required; upstream BM1373 driver behavior must be validated on 8-chip chain

chain.topology: single 8-chip logical UART daisy chain spanning two four-chip voltage domains
chain.boundary_rule: domain-crossing signals require level-shifting topology copied/adapted only from validated open hardware; no guessed direct connection
chain.partial_chain_policy: fail closed; do not hash with missing ASICs

reset.policy: controller-controlled common reset with domain-safe level translation
reset.startup: hold reset through rail stabilization and cooling interlock validation
reset.fault: assert reset before disabling VCORE where sequencing permits

clock.rule: do not freeze oscillator frequency, amplitude, termination, or fanout until validated from BM1373 open hardware or measurement
clock.pll: firmware may program BM1373 PLL only using verified upstream register behavior

telemetry.temperature: external/board sensing required; BM1373 junction sensing path remains unclaimed until verified

manufacturing_blockers: validated BM1373 signal-level schematic for four-chip voltage-domain crossing
exact level-shifter MPNs and passive values
bench proof of eight-chip discovery and stable share submission
fault-injection validation for missing ASIC, UART failure, and cooling loss
